_comment: FEATURES — Branding & Design (svc.branding).
One row per capability, with a permanent language-neutral id. The EN/AR
labels here are the ONLY place those words are authored; index.html and
pricing.json stop carrying their own copies.
PUBLIC vs INTERNAL. `name`, `description`, `purpose` and `pricing` are
public — the builder renders them. Everything from `inputs` down is
internal and is stripped by tools/build-catalogue.js before anything
reaches a browser. The brief is explicit: a visitor sees no workflow ids,
no automation fields, no internal status.
`automationPotential` is an honest four-point scale, not aspiration:
none    — judgement or craft; an agent would produce something worse
assist  — an agent prepares, a person decides
partial — an agent does most of it, a person approves before it ships
full    — an agent can complete it unattended once inputs are present
`pricing.type` is the distinction the builder must show the buyer:
included — part of the service, no separate charge
fixed    — a fixed price, once
unit     — priced per item, with a quantity
project  — scoped per project, with a floor
quote    — cannot be priced without talking; shows Custom quote, never
an invented number
PRICES RAISED 8 SEPTEMBER for the same arithmetic reason as the website
features: costing each package out of its own parts gave 1.17, 0.95 and
0.81, so two of the three branding packages cost more than buying their
contents one by one. They now sit at 1.62, 1.30 and 1.59.
THE THREE PUBLISHED ADD-ON PRICES ARE UNTOUCHED — 15 a social design, 90 a
presentation, 150 a company profile. Those are what the studio sells. Every
other figure here is our own estimate, and a build-time check now keeps them
coherent with the packages they add up to.

description.en: A primary mark, drawn for your business, delivered in every format you will need it in.
description.ar: علامة أساسية مصمّمة خصيصًا لعملك، تُسلَّم بكل الصيغ التي ستحتاجها.

purpose.en: The one thing everything else in the identity is built from.
purpose.ar: الأساس الذي تُبنى عليه بقية عناصر الهوية.

inputs: Business name in every language it will appear in
executionSteps: Read the questionnaire and write a one-paragraph direction before drawing.
Sketch and develop distinct concepts — distinct in idea, not in colourway.
Present concepts in context, never as a mark floating on white.
Take the chosen concept through the agreed revision rounds.
Construct the final mark on a grid and build the format set.
qualityChecks: Legible at 16px and at three metres
Works in one colour and reversed out
No effect that fails in print
Name spelled correctly in every language it carries
No resemblance found in a reverse-image and trademark search
features.completionCriteria: Client has approved one mark in writing and the full format set has been delivered and opened.

revisionRules.scope: Refinement of the chosen concept. A new direction restarts the concept stage and is quoted.

description.en: A defined palette — primary, secondary and neutrals — with the values for screen and for print.
description.ar: لوحة ألوان محدَّدة — أساسية وثانوية ومحايدة — بقيمها للشاشة وللطباعة.

purpose.en: So two people designing on different days produce the same colours.
purpose.ar: حتى ينتج شخصان يعملان في يومين مختلفين الألوان نفسها.

inputs: Where the brand will appear — screen, print, signage, or all three
executionSteps: Derive the palette from the approved mark, not from a trend.
Set roles: primary, secondary, neutral, and one state colour if the brand needs it.
Specify HEX, RGB, CMYK and Pantone where print is in scope.
Test every text-on-background pair that the brand will actually use.
outputs: Named palette with roles and values
qualityChecks: Every text pair meets 4.5:1, or is documented as display-only
CMYK conversions checked, not assumed
Palette survives greyscale
features.completionCriteria: Palette approved and every value present for every medium in scope.

description.en: The typefaces the brand uses, the sizes and weights for each role, and — where the brand is bilingual — the Arabic face that pairs with them.
description.ar: الخطوط التي تستخدمها العلامة، ومقاساتها وأوزانها لكل استخدام، والخط العربي المقابل إن كانت العلامة بلغتين.

purpose.en: So headings, body and captions look deliberate rather than picked each time.
purpose.ar: حتى تبدو العناوين والنصوص والتعليقات مقصودة لا مختارة في كل مرة.

inputs: Which languages the brand publishes in
Licence budget, or a constraint to open-licensed faces
executionSteps: Choose a display and a text face that hold up at the sizes actually used.
Where the brand is bilingual, pair an Arabic face by proportion and weight, never by name.
Define a scale with roles rather than a list of sizes.
Confirm the licence covers web, print and handover to the client.
qualityChecks: Arabic and Latin sit on a shared optical baseline at every size
Every weight used is actually available in the licence
Body face legible at 14px on a phone
features.completionCriteria: Scale approved and the licence position confirmed in writing.

description.en: A single sheet holding the mark, the colours and the type — the short version of a guideline.
description.ar: صفحة واحدة تجمع الشعار والألوان والخطوط — النسخة المختصرة من دليل العلامة.

purpose.en: Enough to hand a printer or a freelancer without writing an email.
purpose.ar: تكفي لتسليمها لمطبعة أو مصمم مستقل دون شرح إضافي.

executionSteps: Lay out mark, clear space, palette values and type scale on one sheet.
Export as a PDF that prints correctly at A4.
qualityChecks: Every value on the sheet matches the source files
Prints legibly in one colour
features.completionCriteria: PDF delivered and every value cross-checked against the approved systems.

description.en: A compact document covering the mark, its misuse, the palette, the type and the basic applications.
description.ar: مستند مختصر يغطي الشعار وسوء استخدامه والألوان والخطوط والتطبيقات الأساسية.

purpose.en: So the brand survives being used by someone who was not in the room.
purpose.ar: حتى تبقى العلامة سليمة بيد من لم يشارك في تصميمها.

executionSteps: Document the mark: construction, clear space, minimum size, approved versions.
Show misuse explicitly — the rules people break are the ones worth drawing.
Document palette and type with their values.
Show two or three applications in context.
qualityChecks: Every rule shown as well as stated
No value that disagrees with the source files
Readable on a phone as well as printed
features.completionCriteria: Document delivered and every value cross-checked against the approved systems.
features._supersedes: A short guidelines document contains everything the one-sheet identity card does and then keeps going. Without this, Professional read as having dropped something Starter had — which is how the ladder check found it.

description.en: The full document — mark, system, voice, imagery, layout rules and every application in scope.
description.ar: المستند الكامل — الشعار والنظام ونبرة الصوت والصور وقواعد التنسيق وكل التطبيقات ضمن النطاق.

purpose.en: The version an agency, a printer and a new hire can all work from.
purpose.ar: النسخة التي يمكن أن تعمل بها وكالة ومطبعة وموظف جديد على حد سواء.

executionSteps: Everything in the short guidelines, at full depth.
Add the visual language: imagery, graphic devices, iconography, motion where it exists.
Add layout rules — grid, margins, hierarchy — with worked examples.
Add the applications the project actually produced, in context.
Add a file index naming where every asset lives.
qualityChecks: Every rule shown as well as stated
No value that disagrees with the source files
File index resolves to files that exist in the handover archive
features.completionCriteria: Document delivered, index verified against the handover archive.

description.en: The brand's non-logo vocabulary — graphic devices, imagery direction, iconography and the way things are cropped and composed.
description.ar: مفردات العلامة خارج الشعار — العناصر الجرافيكية واتجاه الصور والأيقونات وطريقة القص والتكوين.

purpose.en: What makes a post recognisable as yours before the logo appears.
purpose.ar: ما يجعل المنشور معروفًا أنه لك قبل أن يظهر الشعار.

executionSteps: Define two or three devices that can be recombined, not a decoration set.
Set an imagery direction with real reference images, and say what is excluded.
Draw an icon set only where the brand will actually use one.
Prove the language on three unrelated layouts.
qualityChecks: Recognisable with the logo removed
Works on a photo and on a flat colour
Holds at a phone's width
features.completionCriteria: Language approved and demonstrated on three layouts.

description.en: Both sides, set up for print.
description.ar: الوجهان، جاهزان للطباعة.

purpose.en: The application people still ask for first.
purpose.ar: التطبيق الذي ما زال يُطلب أولًا.

inputs: Names, titles and contact details as they should be printed, in every language
executionSteps: Lay out both sides at the agreed size.
Set bleed, trim and safe area.
Proof every detail against what the client wrote, not against what it should say.
qualityChecks: 3mm bleed present
No text inside 4mm of trim
Every phone number and address proofread against the client's own written copy
CMYK, not RGB
features.completionCriteria: Print-ready file delivered and the client has confirmed the details are correct.

description.en: A letterhead set up for print and as an editable document.
description.ar: ورق رسمي جاهز للطباعة وكمستند قابل للتحرير.

purpose.en: So an ordinary letter still looks like it came from you.
purpose.ar: حتى يبدو الخطاب العادي صادرًا عنك.

inputs: Registered company details as they must legally appear
executionSteps: Set the sheet with a body area that a typist can actually use.
Produce both a print artwork and an editable document version.
qualityChecks: Body area does not collide with the header at any page length
Editable version keeps the type when opened on a machine without the fonts
features.completionCriteria: Both versions delivered and the editable one opened successfully by the client.

description.en: Profile and cover artwork cut to each platform's own dimensions.
description.ar: صورة الملف والغلاف بمقاسات كل منصة.

purpose.en: So the mark survives a circular crop and a phone-width cover.
purpose.ar: حتى يبقى الشعار سليمًا داخل قص دائري وغلاف بعرض الهاتف.

inputs: The list of platforms in use
executionSteps: Build a profile mark that survives a circular crop at 40px.
Cut covers to each platform's current safe area, not to last year's.
outputs: Profile and cover set per platform
deliverables: PNG per platform, at the platform's stated size
qualityChecks: Nothing important inside the crop on any platform
Mark legible at 40px
Cover checked at phone width, where the safe area is narrowest
features.completionCriteria: Set delivered for every platform in scope and checked live on at least one.

description.en: Individual post designs, made from the brand's own system rather than a template pack.
description.ar: تصاميم منشورات منفردة، مبنية على نظام العلامة لا على قوالب جاهزة.

purpose.en: The unit almost every social plan is counted in.
purpose.ar: الوحدة التي تُحسب بها معظم خطط التواصل.

features._addonName: THE PUBLISHED ADD-ON WORDING, kept exactly as it shipped. An add-on names the UNIT YOU BUY, which is not always the capability's own name — you buy 'a single social media post design', the capability is 'social media post design'. Preserving these verbatim is also what makes this change provably display-neutral: the generated add-ons section is byte-for-byte the hand-typed one it replaces, except for the single defect it fixes.
inputs: Approved brand assets, ours or the client's
executionSteps: Set each post from the brand's type scale and palette.
Check the crop at the platform's feed ratio before exporting.
Export at the platform's stated size, not scaled up.
deliverables: PNG or JPG at platform size
qualityChecks: Text legible at feed size on a phone
Nothing important inside the platform's overlay areas
Arabic set right-to-left with correct shaping where present
features.completionCriteria: Every ordered post approved and exported.

description.en: A reusable set of post layouts — not finished posts, but the frames the posts are made in.
description.ar: مجموعة تخطيطات قابلة لإعادة الاستخدام — ليست منشورات جاهزة، بل الإطارات التي تُصنع فيها.

purpose.en: So a month of posts takes hours rather than days, and still looks like one brand.
purpose.ar: حتى يستغرق شهر من المنشورات ساعات لا أيامًا، ويبقى بمظهر علامة واحدة.

inputs: Approved visual language where in scope
The post types the client actually publishes
executionSteps: Identify the recurring post types rather than inventing categories.
Build one layout per type, with the variable parts marked.
Prove each layout with three different lengths of real copy.
outputs: Layout set with variable regions marked
qualityChecks: Every layout survives copy at three lengths
Every layout works in both languages where the brand is bilingual
No layout that only works with the example image
features.completionCriteria: Layout set approved and demonstrated with real copy.

description.en: A small set of ad frames in the sizes the main platforms require.
description.ar: مجموعة صغيرة من الإطارات الإعلانية بالمقاسات التي تطلبها المنصات الرئيسية.

purpose.en: So an ad can be produced without redesigning it each time.
purpose.ar: حتى يُنتَج الإعلان دون إعادة تصميمه في كل مرة.

inputs: The platforms and placements in use
executionSteps: Build one frame per required ratio.
Mark the variable regions.
Check each against the platform's text and safe-area rules.
qualityChecks: Every ratio the client's platforms require is present
Nothing important inside a platform's overlay area
features.completionCriteria: Frame set approved and one ad produced from it successfully.

description.en: The full frame set — every placement, both languages, with the variable regions defined.
description.ar: مجموعة الإطارات الكاملة — كل المواضع، بلغتين، مع تحديد المناطق المتغيرة.

purpose.en: So a campaign can be built out across placements in an afternoon.
purpose.ar: حتى تُبنى الحملة عبر كل المواضع في فترة واحدة.

inputs: Approved visual language where in scope
executionSteps: Build the frame set across every placement in scope.
Produce each in both languages where the brand is bilingual.
Mark variable regions and state the character limits that keep them working.
qualityChecks: Every placement present
Arabic version is laid out right-to-left, not mirrored mechanically
Character limits tested at the limit
features.completionCriteria: Frame set approved and proven on one real campaign's copy.

description.en: A deck template with the layouts a real presentation needs, editable by the client.
description.ar: قالب عرض يضم التخطيطات التي يحتاجها عرض حقيقي، قابل للتحرير من العميل.

purpose.en: So an internal deck stops undoing the identity.
purpose.ar: حتى يتوقف العرض الداخلي عن نقض الهوية.

inputs: Which software the client actually presents in
executionSteps: Build the layouts a deck actually uses — title, section, text, two-column, image, data, closing.
Set them as real master slides, not as pasted artwork.
Embed or substitute the fonts so it survives the client's machine.
qualityChecks: Masters are editable, not flattened images
Opens correctly on a machine without the brand fonts
Works at 16:9 and 4:3 if the client uses both
features.completionCriteria: Template delivered and the client has built one slide from it.

description.en: A finished deck, designed slide by slide from your content.
description.ar: عرض تقديمي مكتمل، مصمَّم شريحة بشريحة من محتواك.

purpose.en: For the deck that has to win something.
purpose.ar: للعرض الذي يجب أن يكسب شيئًا.

features._addonName: THE PUBLISHED ADD-ON WORDING, kept exactly as it shipped. An add-on names the UNIT YOU BUY, which is not always the capability's own name — you buy 'a single social media post design', the capability is 'social media post design'. Preserving these verbatim is also what makes this change provably display-neutral: the generated add-ons section is byte-for-byte the hand-typed one it replaces, except for the single defect it fixes.
inputs: Approved brand assets, ours or the client's
executionSteps: Read the content and restructure it before designing it.
Design each slide to one idea.
Rebuild data as designed charts rather than pasted screenshots.
qualityChecks: Every slide readable from the back of a room
No pasted screenshot standing in for a chart
Numbers on charts checked against the client's own source
features.completionCriteria: Deck approved and delivered in both formats.

revisionRules.scope: Design revisions. Content changes after approval are quoted.

description.en: A company profile layout the client can refill as the business changes.
description.ar: تخطيط ملف تعريفي يمكن للعميل إعادة تعبئته كلما تغيّر العمل.

purpose.en: So next year's profile does not need us.
purpose.ar: حتى لا يحتاج ملف العام القادم إلينا.

inputs: The sections the client's profile actually contains
executionSteps: Build one layout per recurring section.
Mark the variable regions and state their limits.
Deliver in software the client owns.
qualityChecks: Every section type present
Survives sections of different lengths
Editable on the client's own software
features.completionCriteria: Template delivered and the client has refilled one section successfully.

description.en: A finished company profile — written where you need it written, designed and print-ready.
description.ar: ملف تعريفي مكتمل — يُكتب عند الحاجة، ويُصمَّم ويُجهَّز للطباعة.

purpose.en: The document a tender or a bank asks for.
purpose.ar: المستند الذي تطلبه المناقصة أو البنك.

features._addonName: THE PUBLISHED ADD-ON WORDING, kept exactly as it shipped. An add-on names the UNIT YOU BUY, which is not always the capability's own name — you buy 'a single social media post design', the capability is 'social media post design'. Preserving these verbatim is also what makes this change provably display-neutral: the generated add-ons section is byte-for-byte the hand-typed one it replaces, except for the single defect it fixes.
inputs: Whether we write the content or the client supplies it
executionSteps: Agree the section list before writing or designing anything.
Write or edit the content.
Design the pages.
Prepare a print-ready file and a screen file separately.
qualityChecks: Every claim in the text traceable to something the client supplied
Print file carries bleed and CMYK
Screen file under 10MB and readable on a phone
features.completionCriteria: Both files delivered and the client has confirmed every factual detail.

revisionRules.scope: Design and copy revisions within the agreed section list.

description.en: Editable layouts the client fills in themselves, in software they already have.
description.ar: تخطيطات قابلة للتحرير يملؤها العميل بنفسه، ببرامج يملكها فعلًا.

purpose.en: So routine content stops being a request.
purpose.ar: حتى يتوقف المحتوى الروتيني عن كونه طلبًا.

inputs: Which software the client's team can actually use
executionSteps: Agree which content types recur often enough to be worth a template.
Build each with the editable regions locked apart from the fixed ones.
Write a one-page instruction that assumes no design knowledge.
qualityChecks: A non-designer can produce a correct item from each template unaided
Fixed regions cannot be edited by accident
features.completionCriteria: Templates delivered and the client has produced one item from one of them without help.

description.en: A shoot, on location, with selection and retouching.
description.ar: جلسة تصوير في الموقع، مع الاختيار والمعالجة.

purpose.en: So the brand shows its own work instead of stock.
purpose.ar: حتى تعرض العلامة عملها الحقيقي بدل الصور الجاهزة.

inputs: A shot list agreed in advance
Access, permits and any people appearing
executionSteps: Agree the shot list and the number of final images before the day.
Shoot to the list, then shoot beyond it.
Select, then retouch only the selected.
Deliver at print and screen resolutions.
qualityChecks: Every item on the agreed shot list covered
Colour consistent across the set
Written permission held for every identifiable person
features.completionCriteria: The agreed number of final images delivered and receipt confirmed.

revisionRules.scope: Retouching of selected images. A reshoot is a new booking.

quoteReason.en: Priced by location, day count and the number of final images.
quoteReason.ar: يُسعَّر حسب الموقع وعدد الأيام وعدد الصور النهائية.

description.en: A shoot for video, with the footage delivered ready to edit.
description.ar: تصوير فيديو، مع تسليم اللقطات جاهزة للمونتاج.

purpose.en: The footage everything else is cut from.
purpose.ar: اللقطات التي يُبنى منها كل ما بعدها.

inputs: Access, permits and any people appearing
executionSteps: Agree the treatment and the deliverable lengths before the day.
Shoot with sound captured separately where dialogue is involved.
Back up on site, twice, before leaving.
Deliver organised, labelled footage.
qualityChecks: Two backups made before leaving the location
Audio checked on headphones during the shoot, not after
Every item on the treatment covered
features.completionCriteria: Footage delivered, logged, and confirmed openable by whoever edits it.

revisionRules.scope: A reshoot is a new booking.

quoteReason.en: Priced by location, day count, crew and the deliverables cut from it.
quoteReason.ar: يُسعَّر حسب الموقع وعدد الأيام وفريق العمل والمخرجات المطلوبة.

description.en: The exported files you need to use the identity, without the editable sources.
description.ar: الملفات المصدَّرة اللازمة لاستخدام الهوية، دون الملفات القابلة للتحرير.

purpose.en: Enough to hand to a printer or upload anywhere.
purpose.ar: تكفي لتسليمها لمطبعة أو رفعها في أي مكان.

executionSteps: Export every approved item in the agreed formats.
Name files so a stranger can find one.
Deliver as a single archive.
qualityChecks: Every file opens
No file named 'final-2'
Archive downloaded and opened once by us before it is sent
features.completionCriteria: Archive delivered and the client has confirmed it opened.

revisionRules.scope: Missing files are supplied, not revised.

description.en: The exports plus the editable sources everything was made in.
description.ar: الملفات المصدَّرة مع الملفات المصدرية القابلة للتحرير.

purpose.en: So another designer can continue the work without redrawing it.
purpose.ar: حتى يتمكن مصمم آخر من إكمال العمل دون إعادة رسمه.

executionSteps: Everything in the basic export set.
Add the editable sources, with layers named.
Add font licences or links.
Deliver as a single structured archive.
qualityChecks: Every source opens on a machine that is not ours
Layers named
Fonts either embedded, licensed to the client, or replaced with ones that are
features.completionCriteria: Archive delivered and one source file opened successfully by the client.

revisionRules.scope: Missing files are supplied, not revised.

description.en: The whole archive — every item, every format, every source, indexed.
description.ar: الأرشيف بالكامل — كل عنصر وكل صيغة وكل ملف مصدري، مفهرسة.

purpose.en: So the brand is genuinely yours the day the project ends.
purpose.ar: حتى تصبح العلامة ملكك فعلًا يوم انتهاء المشروع.

inputs: The guidelines document where in scope
executionSteps: Everything in the source set.
Add photography, templates and any produced content.
Write an index naming what each folder holds.
Verify the index against the archive, file by file.
qualityChecks: Index resolves to files that exist
Archive downloaded and opened once by us before it is sent
Nothing in it references a file we did not deliver
features.completionCriteria: Archive delivered, index verified, and the client has confirmed receipt.

revisionRules.scope: Missing files are supplied, not revised.
